expressibility_note: Reversal: modified baseline starts the exclusion (excluded=true) and the matching saving birth-date cut-off at the earlier pre-delay date, which the PMD text does not state; current law has 15 May 2019. Parameters are read at 30 April of the model year, so in-year start dates shift by a model year, and the saving is inferred from reported receipt and birth date.

expressibility_note: The description reads 'removing the two-child limit', but the ~60m-a-year cost matches exempting children born before 6 April 2017 in UC (reg 24A(3) as reworded from 1 February 2019, cited in born_before.yaml), not abolishing the limit. Construction: modified baseline without the born_before exemption, current law 20170406.
measure: Universal credit: removing the two-child limit
missing_machinery: No UC claim start date or transitional-protection status: the pre-measure rule would have applied the limit to children born before 6 April 2017 only in new claims, so dropping the born_before exemption in PE would hit continuing claims too.
scope_note: The UC child limit is a household benefit entitlement rule.
